(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

    if (!rst_n) begin
        out <= 4'd0;
    end else if (valid_count) begin
        if (out == 4'd11) begin
            out <= 4'd0;
        end else begin
            out <= out + 1;
        end
    end
end

endmodule

	input 				clk_b	,

);

	if (!brstn) begin
		sync_reg2 <= 4'b0;
	end else begin
		sync_reg2 <= sync_reg1;
	end
end

always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
	if (!brstn) begin
		dataout <= 4'b0;
	end else begin
		dataout <= sync_reg2;
	end
end

endmodule

module synchronizer(
	input 				clk_a	, 
	input 				clk_b	,   
	input 				arstn	,
	input				brstn   ,
	input		[3:0]	data_in	,
	input               data_en ,

	output reg  [3:0] 	dataout
);

reg [3:0] sync_reg_a, sync_reg_b;

always @(posedge clk_a or negedge arstn) begin
	if (!arstn) begin
		sync_reg_a <= 4'b0;
	end else begin
		if (data_en) begin
			sync_reg_a <= data_in;
		end
	end
end

always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
	if (!brstn) begin
		sync_reg_b <= 4'b0;
	end else begin
		sync_reg_b <= sync_reg_a;
	end
end

always @(posedge clk_b or negedge brstn) begin
	if (!brstn) begin
		dataout <= 4'b0;
	end else begin
		dataout <= sync_reg_b;
	end
end

endmodule
